title: Question 26
passage:
There’s a long line for the cloakroom, and the concert is about to start.
A. The line was even longer last week. B. Let’s keep our coats with us and find our seats. C. I bought the tickets online.
passageZh:
寄物處排了好長的隊，演奏會又快開始了。
A. 上週隊伍還更長。 B. 我們把外套帶在身上，先去找座位吧。 C. 我是在網路上買票的。
